sloka: कच्चित् स्वादु कृतं भोज्यमेको नाश्नासि राघव ।कच्चिदाशंसमानेभ्यो मित्रेभ्य: सम्प्रयच्छसि ॥ २.१००.७६॥
transliteration: kaccit svādu kṛtaṁ bhojyameko nāśnāsi rāghava ।kaccidāśaṁsamānebhyo mitrebhya: samprayacchasi ॥ 2.100.76॥

translations.english: The highly sagacious and learned king, having acquired the entire earth and punishing the people in accordance with tradition and righteously ruling the kingdom, will ascend the his release (from this world). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे शततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundredth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
